llm_analysis.reasoning: Justin has strong production C++ and computer vision foundations with genuine real-world robot integration (COFFIN demonstrates multi-tier architecture and actual hardware validation). However, Saildrone's perception role requires state estimation and localization algorithms (Kalman filtering, SLAM, visual odometry) that are entirely missing—only theoretical exposure via coursework. Additionally, all robotics testing is lab-based; he lacks the field deployment experience that Saildrone emphasizes as core to their 'combat-deployed' systems operating 24/7 globally. He is strong on implementation and systems thinking but missing algorithmic depth in autonomy fundamentals and real-world operational experience.
